verdict.rationale: Pipecat Evals is a documented built-in testing system: you describe a conversation and the expected behavior, and it runs that against your real agent pipeline and reports whether the expectation holds. A runtime probe confirms the official CLI ships an `eval` command for behavioral evals, and the dev runner lets developers talk to the bot in a browser before wiring up telephony. missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of an eval run (the probe only listed the command), and documentation depth beyond the overview, such as simulated caller personas, audio- or telephony-level simulation, and CI or regression reporting.
